map.由厚度、导热系数与面积求热阻: Thermal Resistance from Thickness, Conductivity and Area
map.输入厚度 L、导热系数 k、面积 A，求热阻。: Input thickness L, thermal conductivity k and area A to find thermal resistance.
map.📖 查看「由厚度、导热系数与面积求热阻 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Thermal Resistance from Thickness, Conductivity and Area User Guide"
map.多层壁总热阻叠加: Total thermal resistance of multi-layer walls adds up
map.R = d/(k*A)（单层）。三层墙各 R1,R2,R3 串联总 R=R1+R: R = d/(k*A) (single layer). A three-layer wall has R1,R2,R3 in series, total R=R1+R2+R3, total heat flow q=ΔT/R_total, analogous to a circuit
map.实际层间有接触热阻，设计留余量；对流/辐射边界也折算为表面热阻。: Real interlayers have contact thermal resistance; design with a margin; convection/radiation boundaries are also converted to surface thermal resistance.
map.增大总热阻：加厚、用低 k 材料、加空气层、减少接触热阻。: Increase total thermal resistance: thicken, use low-k material, add air layer, reduce contact thermal resistance.
map.多层壁的总热阻怎么叠加？: How do you stack the total thermal resistance of a multi-layer wall?
map.串联叠加即可：R_total=R1+R2+R3…，与电路中: Just series stacking: R_total=R1+R2+R3…, the same as in a circuit
map.同理。例如三层材料 R 分别为 0.1000、0.5000、0.0500 K/W: Similarly. E.g. three-layer materials with R of 0.1000, 0.5000, 0.0500 K/W give total 0.6500 K/W; at 20 K difference heat flow q=ΔT/R_total≈30.8 W.
